parsed.why: No trans-specific offence and some official goodwill, but police documented as foremost abusers of LGBTI people, extortion, forced anal/vaginal exams, no anti-discrimination recourse, and birth-sex prison default with only discretionary exception.

No criminalisation, courts protect bathroom access and struck surgery requirement; but custody follows family register, documented trans detainee held among men, mocked, hormones delayed, and no anti-discrimination statute or enforceable violence protection.

Strong recognition, marriage and a transfemicide statute, but rights rarely enforced; police documented as corrupt and abusive toward trans people, impunity warned of, and repeated anti-trans killings with weak remedy.

Sodomy and gender-neutral indecency statutes remain in force though unenforced; no recognition, no anti-discrimination protection, documented service discrimination and fear of reporting; thin record, no evidence police target trans visitors.

Sodomy law reaching women, documented arrests of people for sexuality or gender identity, active harsher bill, no recognition, no domestic transition care, concealment the norm; only resident-facing employment protection.
